data.one_liner: Flutter plugin providing the native ObjectBox NoSQL database with built‑in Sync support.
data.what_it_does: It bundles the ObjectBox engine and its Sync client as a Flutter plugin for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux. The library lets you store Dart objects locally and keep them synchronized with a remote ObjectBox Sync server.
use_when: You need a high‑performance local NoSQL database with automatic sync to a server
You target multiple desktop and mobile platforms and want a single Dart API
avoid_when: You require a relational SQL database or need full SQL query support
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution without native binaries
weaknesses: Adds native binaries, increasing app size
Limited to ObjectBox ecosystem; no SQL support
data.setup_notes: Add objectbox_sync_flutter_libs (and objectbox) to pubspec.yaml, run flutter pub get, and ensure platform‑specific native dependencies are available (e.g., C++ toolchain for desktop). No additional code‑generation required.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure SQLite wrapper, good for relational data and smaller binary size

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: SQL‑based ORM with code generation, supports complex queries

alternatives.name: sqlite3
alternatives.why_pick_it: Low‑level SQLite bindings for custom use cases
